slides.h: EVERY FAD LOOKS LIKE A BUSINESS FOR [[THREE WEEKS]]
slides.dek: Four tests before you put real money into a trending product.

body: Will anyone buy this twice? A product people buy once is a campaign, and every campaign has an end date.
Repeat purchase is what turns a spike into a shop.
Price a sale for the week after the hype cools. If the numbers only work during the spike, the spike owns your business.
Can you restock before the wave ends? When your supplier needs three weeks and the trend has two, you are buying leftover demand at full price.
Would you still stock it in February? A real product survives the months when nobody is talking about it.

slides.body: Tell us in the comments. Every seller has one, and the story helps the next seller.
